entities.name: Always-on PDU session requested
entities.description: Information element indicating the UE requests the PDU session to be an always-on PDU session in 5GS.

entities.name: PDN connection establishment
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a PDN connection when in S1 mode.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Condition where UE moves from S1 mode to N1 mode.

entities.name: UE operating in single-registration mode in network supporting N26 interface
entities.description: Condition where UE operates in single-registration mode and network supports N26 interface.

entities.name: UE has not previously successfully performed UE-requested PDU session modification
entities.description: Condition where UE has not previously successfully performed PDU session modification to provide always-on capability.

entities.name: UE requests always-on PDU session
entities.description: Condition where UE requests the PDU session to be an always-on PDU session in 5GS.

relations.description: The PDN connection establishment message shall include the Always-on PDU session requested IE when specified conditions are met.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition of inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition of UE operating in single-registration mode in network supporting N26 interface.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that UE has not previously successfully performed PDU session modification for this capability.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that UE requests the PDU session to be always-on in 5GS.
